head: One Cent Start gives you one short reading each morning
dek: One Cent Start opens each morning to one page: the date, a short reflection you can read in under a minute and a simple meditation, for all 366 days of the year. It was #41 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: A photograph sets the mood for each week. It costs $3.99, by Nenad Zlatanovic.
means: If you want a calm minute before your day starts, it gives you one page and nothing else.
todo: Find One Cent Start in the App Store.
